entities.name: 5GSM STATUS message
entities.description: A 5G session management status message received by the UE containing a 5GSM cause value.

entities.name: 5GSM cause value
entities.description: An information element in the 5GSM STATUS message indicating the reason for the status.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: An identifier used to associate 5GSM procedures with specific transactions.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: An identifier for a PDU session in 5G system.

entities.name: 5GSM procedure
entities.description: An ongoing 5G session management procedure in the UE.

entities.name: Related timer
entities.description: A timer associated with an ongoing 5GSM procedure.

entities.name: Invalid PTI value
entities.description: Condition when received 5GSM STATUS message contains cause value #81 (invalid PTI value).

entities.name: Message type non-existent or not implemented
entities.description: Condition when received 5GSM STATUS message contains cause value #97 (message type non-existent or not implemented).

entities.name: Other 5GSM cause value
entities.description: Condition when received 5GSM STATUS message contains any 5GSM cause value other than #81 or #97.

entities.name: Abort ongoing 5GSM procedure
entities.description: Behavior where the UE terminates any ongoing 5GSM procedure related to the received PTI or PDU session ID.

entities.name: Stop related timer
entities.description: Behavior where the UE stops any timer associated with the ongoing 5GSM procedure.

entities.name: No specific action taken
entities.description: Behavior where no state transition or specific action is taken as seen from the radio interface upon receiving certain 5GSM STATUS messages.

relations.description: The 5GSM STATUS message contains a 5GSM cause value information element.
The 5GSM STATUS message contains a PTI identifier.
Receiving 5GSM STATUS with cause #81 establishes the behavior to abort ongoing 5GSM procedure.
Receiving 5GSM STATUS with cause #81 establishes the behavior to stop related timer.
Receiving 5GSM STATUS with cause #97 establishes the behavior to abort ongoing 5GSM procedure.
Receiving 5GSM STATUS with cause #97 establishes the behavior to stop related timer.
Receiving 5GSM STATUS with any other cause value establishes no specific action behavior.
5GSM cause value #81 guards the condition for invalid PTI value.
5GSM cause value #97 guards the condition for message type non-existent or not implemented.
Any other 5GSM cause value guards the condition for no specific action.
